## Original article text

````markdown
## Description

The surface normal at the ray cast hit position (or from end pos to start pos if no hit occurs). Ray casts ignore players with "Phased Out" status.

==_For a more in-depth guide on ray casts, check out [Ray casts and You](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/ray+casts+and+you)_==

## Snippet

```
Ray Cast Hit Normal(Vector(0, 0, 0), Vector(0, 0, 0), All Players(All Teams), Event Player, True);
```

## Properties

**Returns**: _<span style="color: #c678dd">Direction</span>_
**Parameters**: ==_Start Pos_==, ==_End Pos_==, ==_Players To Include_==, ==_Players To Exclude_==, ==_Include Player Owned Objects_==

> ==**Start Pos**==
> _Type: **Position**, Default: **[Vector](/wiki/articles/vector)**_
> The start position for the ray cast. If a player is provided, a position 2 meters above the player's feet is used.

> ==**End Pos**==
> _Type: **Position**, Default: **[Vector](/wiki/articles/vector)**_
> The end position for the ray cast. If a player is provided, a position 2 meters above the player's feet is used.

> ==**Players To Include**==
> _Type: **Array** (**Player**), Default: **[All Players](/wiki/articles/all-players)**_
> Which players can be hit by this ray cast.

> ==**Players To Exclude**==
> _Type: **Array** (**Player**), Default: **[Event Player](/wiki/articles/event-player)**_
> Which players cannot be hit by this ray cast. This list takes precedence over players to include.

> ==**Include Player Owned Objects**==
> _Type: **Boolean**, Default: **[True](/wiki/articles/true)**_
> Whether player-owned objects (such as barriers or turrets) should be included in the ray cast.
````
